package httpapi

import "net/http"

var shared = http.NewServeMux()

func (rt *Router) register(m *http.ServeMux) {
	m.HandleFunc("GET /param", rt.authz(perm, rt.handler))
}

func (rt *Router) Handler() http.Handler {
	top := http.NewServeMux()
	top.HandleFunc("POST /local", rt.handler)
	var value http.ServeMux
	value.Handle("GET /value", someHandler)
	allocated := new(http.ServeMux)
	allocated.HandleFunc("GET /new", rt.handler)
	literal := &http.ServeMux{}
	literal.HandleFunc("GET /literal", rt.handler)
	alias := top
	alias.HandleFunc("GET /alias", rt.handler)
	shared.HandleFunc("GET /file-level", rt.handler)
	http.HandleFunc("GET /default", rt.handler)
	func(inner *http.ServeMux) {
		inner.HandleFunc("GET /closure", rt.handler)
	}(top)
	return top
}
